source.paraphrase: EventGate.subscribe takes listener first, a nonempty eventType second, and an optional string listenerId.

invariants.why: EventGate and the low-level event bus have different argument order. Reversing them can fail immediately or retain a noncallable listener until delivery. Empty string event types are accepted by the published types/runtime, but the built-in bus fails to remove their listeners; the explicit nonempty-channel policy prevents this leak.
invariants.fixHint: Call kernel.event.subscribe(listener, eventType, listenerId). Store the returned subscription ID when teardown uses that ID.

source.paraphrase: EventGate teardown needs the original listener reference or the returned subscription ID through its matching API.

invariants.why: The gate indexes listeners by function identity and subscription IDs separately. A string passed to unsubscribe or a new callback silently leaves the existing subscription active.
invariants.fixHint: Use kernel.event.unsubscribe(originalListener), or kernel.event.unsubscribeBySubscriptionId(subscriptionId). Do not construct a new listener for removal.
